rules: Deduplicates and sorts entity IDs; filters previously seen items and current task prefix; selects a positively weighted difficulty band then uniform member using SHA256 seed. All tested generated records are hard; positive hard weight preserves full support. Zero hard weight excludes the whole pool. Unconfigured policy picks the lowest eligible entity ID.
assumptions: Fresh hypothetical learner, positive hard weight; indices stand for sorted future entity IDs.
Captured inventory basis 5370; active policy, learner history, future entity IDs and later inventory changes are not captured.
limits: Code inspection and faithful read-only selection reproduction establish support under stated conditions, not live outcomes. History exclusion cannot expand a finite pool or inspect mathematical answer roles. Publication preparation file absent; actual shared delivery filter used instead.
